metadata.title: Pork With Mustard Greens | Laixaak Gahori | Assamese Cuisine
metadata.description:
This amazing recipe where pork is cooked with mustard greens is delicious rustic dish perfect for a steaming hot meal on a cold or rainy day. 

This recipe was given to me by one of my viewer Anurag Bordolai, I tried it out first and it tasted amazing. Thank you for sharing this recipe with me Anurag!
